question: The Prime Minister in August 2021 announced the fortification of rice distributed under various government schemes including the Public Distribution System (PDS) and Mid-Day-Meal scheme by the year __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2024.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Prime Minister announced the fortification of rice by 2024.**
 
• The fortification of rice means adding essential micronutrients such as** iron, zinc, and Vitamin B12 **to the rice to improve its nutritional value.
 
• The fortification of rice is a part of the government's efforts to address malnutrition and improve the health of the population, especially children and women.
 
• The government of India's initiative to serve prepared lunches to students in all government elementary schools is known as the "**Midday Meal Scheme."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The fortification of rice is a cost-effective and sustainable approach to address micronutrient deficiencies, which are prevalent in India.**
 
• The fortification of rice will not alter the taste, texture or cooking properties of rice and will be safe for consumption.
 
• The fortification of rice is already being implemented in some states of India, such as** Odisha, Gujarat, and Andhra Pradesh,** and has shown positive results in improving the nutritional status of the population.
 
• The fortification of rice is a part of the larger food fortification program of the government, which also includes **fortification of wheat flour, oil, and salt.**
